summary: Indian stocks have recovered from a subdued start to trade modestly higher mid-morning, helped by foreign buying and strong earnings, with Bajaj group stocks firm and autos and pharma soft.

detail.leaders: Bajaj Finance and Bajaj Finserv; results winners Hindustan Copper and Tata Power
detail.tone: A live read mid-morning. Without a timestamped index print newer than the previous note, this is a read on behaviour: the market is a little firmer than earlier, having climbed out of its opening range.
watch: Whether the recovery extends past the morning's range
